verdict: Attempt 1 (prefix transforms) regressed distinct-2 by 27.7% and I reverted it too early. The regression was an artifact of MY transform choice, not of the technique. Attempt 2 (entity-masked interior edits, self-derived knobs) improves distinct-2 0.3305 -> 0.3472 on kanto and is landed.

process_correction.what_i_did_wrong: Reverted after ONE implementation, and the write-up itself named the untested confound ('guaranteeing zero fact drift forced prefix-only transforms') without testing it. Prefix-only was an implementation choice made for entity safety, not a property of formatting augmentation. A fix-forward was owed before any revert.
the_confounds_that_were_never_separated: PREFIX vs INTERIOR transform — the paper's method includes in-string edits; only prefixes were tried.
ADDITIVE at fraction 0.5 — doubling the corpus inflates distinct-2's denominator by construction, independent of transform quality.
The knobs were fixed constants rather than measured against the corpus.

the_arithmetic_that_decided_it.method: new-vs-original bigrams per variant, over a 5-bigram sentence
the_arithmetic_that_decided_it.reading: A variant raises distinct-2 only when its new-bigram share beats the corpus's existing ratio. A prefix leaves every interior bigram identical (0.17) and therefore CANNOT clear the bar. An interior edit changes the two bigrams adjacent to each edited token and can. That is the whole difference between the two attempts.

attempt_1_prefix.outcome: REVERTED — correct verdict on that implementation, premature as a verdict on the item.

attempt_2_interior_masked.mechanism: Locate every entity mention's character range, mark those spans protected, and apply markdown emphasis ONLY to tokens outside them. _preserves_payload then re-checks every entity survives verbatim and drops any variant that fails.
attempt_2_interior_masked.knob_derivation: formatting_augment_derived builds each candidate setting (fraction x emphasis), measures distinct-2 on the result, and keeps the best setting that IMPROVES on the un-augmented baseline. If none improves it returns the records untouched. No constant is asked for or hardcoded, and the augmenter is structurally incapable of regressing the metric it exists to help — the exact failure of attempt 1.

honest_caveat_that_survives_the_fix.result: Returns 1 for a surface and its INTERIOR variant, exactly as it did for the prefix variant.
honest_caveat_that_survives_the_fix.meaning: The repo has two diversity measures and they disagree about this mechanism. distinct-n (what the audit's diversity gate rules on, and what the brief named) improves. effective_forms — used by dedup's floor accounting — still treats a formatting variant as the same form, so these variants compete for the same per-fact exposure budget and dedup may cull them.
honest_caveat_that_survives_the_fix.consequence: The gain is real against the gate's ruler but should NOT be described as adding new 'forms'. If dedup runs after this, expect the variants to be candidates for culling; whether that is right depends on whether formatting robustness is worth exposure budget, which is not a question distinct-n can answer.
honest_caveat_that_survives_the_fix.not_papered_over: This was one of the two arguments used to justify the premature revert. It survives the fix-forward and is recorded rather than dropped now that the other argument has fallen.

cases: entities survive every variant (0 unsafe skipped over 60 records at emphasis 4)
no '**' ever lands inside an entity mention (explicit span check at emphasis 6)
interior edit beats a prefix on new-bigram share — pins the arithmetic that decided the two attempts
derived augmentation improves distinct-2 OR declines and returns the input untouched
declines on a corpus it cannot help (identical one-token surfaces)
reports every trial and its score, so the chosen setting is auditable
originals never dropped; deterministic across runs; variants labelled for provenance

deviations: The first revert was premature and is recorded as a process error rather than quietly overwritten. The v1 receipt's conclusion ('a proven no') was wrong; its arithmetic was right about the prefix implementation only.
effective_forms still does not count these as distinct. Reported as a live caveat, not resolved.

Only kanto's template floor was measured. The derived selection re-runs per unit, so another corpus may legitimately choose a different setting or decline entirely — that is the design, but it does mean this gain is not a global claim.
The knob search is a fixed 8-point grid (fraction x emphasis). It is a search, not an optimum; a corpus whose best setting lies outside the grid gets the best in-grid setting or a decline.
